words.meaning: A flat, flexible utensil used for mixing, spreading, or flipping food items.
sentences: She used a silicone spatula to scrape the cake batter from the bowl.
Flip the pancake carefully using a wide spatula.
Make sure you clean the spatula thoroughly after cooking.

words.meaning: A utensil with curved wire loops, used for beating or whipping ingredients smoothly.
sentences: Use a stainless steel whisk to beat the eggs until they are fluffy.
Whisk the flour and milk together to create a smooth batter.
He bought an electric whisk to save time while baking desserts.

words.meaning: A perforated bowl used to drain liquid from foods like pasta or washed vegetables.
sentences: Pour the boiled pasta into the colander to drain the hot water.
She washed the fresh berries thoroughly in a plastic colander.
Place the metal colander inside the sink before straining the liquid.

words.meaning: To cook food gently in a liquid held just below its boiling point.

translations.hindi: धीमी आंच पर पकाना (Dheemi aanch par pakana)

sentences: Let the tomato soup simmer on low heat for twenty minutes.
The aromatic sauce began to simmer gently on the stove.
Cover the pot and allow the vegetable curry to simmer until tender.

words.meaning: A large, deep spoon with a long handle, used for serving soup, stew, or sauce.
sentences: He used a wooden ladle to serve the hot soup into deep bowls.
Dip the ladle into the pot to stir the thick stew gently.
Stainless steel ladles are durable and easy to clean for daily kitchen use.
